content.sprint_notes: Sprint 2 CLOSED 2026-04-12. Velocity 2/2. Product backend + frontend complete. BUG-0003 (critical, fixed): TransformInterceptor envelope not unwrapped. BUG-0004 (critical, fixed): admin storeId null coerced. Sprint 3 IN PROGRESS: backend done, frontend pages exist but need AppLayout/nav (Sprint 4). 10-sprint extension planned: Sprints 4-13 covering demo-ready frontend → reporting → catalog+ → advanced POS → tax compliance → admin multistore → realtime → E2E → production.

audit.author: vibe-backend-nestjs
audit.note: Sprint 1 backend fully implemented. Auth module: JWT access (15m) + refresh (7d, Redis rotation), bcryptjs cost 12, no-enumeration 401 (BR-AUTH-08), RolesGuard, JwtAuthGuard + @Public bypass. Stores module: taxCode immutable, soft-delete, deactivate flushes Redis sessions. 2 migrations, admin seed. Build passing, 11 tests green. API contracts approved.

audit.author: vibe-backend-nestjs
audit.note: BUG-0004 (critical) created and fixed. Admin user storeId=null was coerced to '' in jwt.strategy.ts, crashing all products endpoints with QueryFailedError: invalid input syntax for type uuid: "". Fixed by preserving null in JWT strategy, widening AuthUser.storeId to string|null, and adding ForbiddenException guards in ProductsService (all public methods) and StoresService.findMyStore. tsc --noEmit clean.

audit.author: vibe-qa-general
audit.note: BUG-0003 (critical) created and fixed. TransformInterceptor { data, meta } envelope was not unwrapped by frontend api-client.ts. All login attempts stored undefined tokens; RequireAuth bounced every user back to /login. Fixed with response interceptor + refresh-token path unwrap.
